about: Test vectors for passkey approvals (spec/action-records-v1.md, section 10). Generated by testvectors/generate.py from the Python reference implementation with a deterministic software authenticator; every key is derived from a public seed, never use one for real. A case is a trail (records in order, each with its CID), the principals file the auditor trusts, and the problems a verifier must report, in order; none means the approvals verify.
